overview: Unanet uses API key (Bearer token) authentication. You generate an access token from the Unanet admin panel and include it in the Authorization header with every request.

steps.title: Contact your Unanet admin
steps.description: API access in Unanet must be enabled by an administrator. Ask your Unanet admin to enable API access for your account.

steps.title: Generate an API token
steps.description: In Unanet, go to Admin → API → Access Tokens. Click 'New Token', configure the permissions, and generate. Copy the token immediately.
steps.warning: Copy the token immediately — it may only be shown once.

steps.title: Note your instance name
steps.description: Your Unanet instance URL is in the format: https://{instance}.unanet.biz. Note the {instance} part — it is required as connection config.

steps.title: Create the connection
steps.tip: Use a unique connection_id per Unanet instance.

tips: Unanet API tokens can be scoped — request only the permissions your integration needs.
If a token is compromised, revoke it from Admin → API → Access Tokens and generate a new one.
